title: Move selected links to a campaign
limits: Up to 500 links per operation. A plan with campaigns is required.
selection: {count, plural, one {# link selected across pages and filters.} other {# links selected across pages and filters.}}
effect: Move all {count} selected links to one campaign. Each UTM variant keeps its source, medium, term and content. Campaign defaults do not overwrite these values. Old campaign containers remain.
empty: No matching campaigns. Create a campaign or change your search.
pickerHelp: Browse 25 matches per page or search by title. Your chosen campaign stays selected across result pages.
confirm: Replace previous campaign associations for all {count} selected links.
success: Moved {updated} of {selected} selected links. Links already assigned to this campaign needed no update.
reviewHelp: Browse the {count} selected links below. Filters only change this review; the operation applies to the full selection.
matching: {count} of {total} selected links match this view.
emptyReview: No selected links match these filters.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to move these links. Ask a workspace admin.
errors.feature_required: Your current plan does not include campaigns. Review your plan or ask a workspace admin.
errors.not_found: The selection or campaign has expired or is no longer available. Nothing changed. Return to Links and select again.
errors.invalid_input: Choose a campaign and confirm the move. Select no more than 500 links.
errors.failed: The campaign move could not finish. Your selection is kept. Try again.
